experiment_data.hypothesis: At r=0.25 (25% real data), SLV trajectory will disambiguate the r_crit boundary between r=0.2 (dip-then-recovery, no collapse in 5gen) and r=0.3. If r=0.25 shows sustained SLV decline over 10 generations, r_crit lies in [0.2, 0.25]. If it recovers like r=0.2, r_crit is below 0.2. This precisely locates the phase transition boundary for the mixing-ratio phase diagram (C2 claim).
